description: This file defines the interface for the Cvd class, including its constructor and methods for handling various commands related to the Cvd component in the Android Cuttlefish project. It also includes necessary headers and declares private member references to other components.

classes.name: Cvd
classes.description: A class that manages commands for the Cvd component, including handling command arguments, environment variables, and managing dependencies like InstanceManager and InstanceLockFileManager.

methods.name: Cvd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Cvd object with references to InstanceManager and InstanceLockFileManager.

methods.name: HandleCommand
methods.description: Handles a generic command with process arguments, environment variables, and selector arguments.

methods.name: HandleCvdCommand
methods.description: Handles commands specific to the Cvd component based on all arguments and environment.

methods.name: HandleAcloud
methods.description: Handles 'Acloud' related commands with arguments and environment variables.
